text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel tells you nothing about bias against you on grounds of sex. All-male panels are worth noting as a governance weakness — and may matter for women who applied — but they can't explain why one man was chosen over another. Raising it would likely read as grasping and undercut your credibility.

Your stronger ground is substantive: you appear to out-qualify him on the modelling criteria, so the panel needs to show how "broad regulatory experience" was weighted and whether that was in the advertised criteria. Chase the written explanation in writing, cite any internal recruitment policy and deadline, and ask for the scoring matrix and panel notes.
